newsitem.title: GERMANY: German Data Due - GDP 3rd qtr, full year 1996.
newsitem.headline: German Data Due - GDP 3rd qtr, full year 1996.

text.p: The Federal Statistics Office said on Thursday it would publish German third quarter gross domestic product data on December 4 at 0700 GMT.
It also said it would publish GDP data for 1996 on January 9, 1997 at a news conference at 0900 GMT.
Further details about statistics office reports can be obtained from the office's home page on the World Wide Web at http://www.statistik-bund.de.
